title: Login returns a 500 error
description: Users cannot log in after a backend deployment.
resolution: Check application logs, review the latest deployment, and verify authentication service health.

title: Database connection timeout
description: The application cannot connect to the database and dashboard requests fail.
resolution: Check database availability, connection settings, network access, and connection pool limits.

title: Slow dashboard loading
description: The dashboard takes a long time to load due to slow API responses.
resolution: Inspect API response times, check slow database queries, and review application performance metrics.

title: DNS resolution failure
description: The service cannot resolve the hostname of an external API.
resolution: Verify the hostname, DNS configuration, network connectivity, and external service availability.

title: Suspicious login attempt
description: Multiple unexpected login attempts were detected on a user account.
resolution: Follow the security incident process, review authentication logs, and escalate to the security team.

title: Database query failed
description: A SQL query fails while loading customer records.
resolution: Inspect the query, validate the schema and parameters, and review the database error logs.

title: Intermittent API connection failure
description: Requests to the API occasionally fail with connection errors.
resolution: Check network connectivity, API health, timeout settings, and relevant service logs.

title: Application deployment failed
description: The latest deployment failed and the application is not starting correctly.
resolution: Review deployment logs, validate environment variables, and check application startup errors.
